risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively well quantified, identifying substantial shipment and sales declines, COVID-19-related disruption, cost dependence, and a $182.6 million goodwill impairment. Risk is material and concentrated in automotive demand, customer production, pandemic uncertainty, geographic recovery differences, and valuation sensitivity, although management describes detailed mitigation actions and operational recovery.
